name: Can any wall be modified for a larger window?
description: Most walls can be modified, but load-bearing walls require more extensive structural support and careful engineering.

mainEntity.name: Can any wall be modified for a larger window?

acceptedAnswer.text: While most walls can be modified, not all are equally suitable for large window enlargements. Load-bearing walls require more extensive structural support, such as new or reinforced headers, compared to non-load-bearing walls. We always conduct a thorough structural analysis to determine the feasibility and engineering requirements, advising on the safest and most effective approach for your specific home's construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most walls can be modified, but load-bearing walls require more extensive structural support and careful engineering.
